messages:
ben_sales: Hey team — lead wants a 6mo Dedicated POC + optional 3yr immutable audit-log retention (HIPAA scope). They also want to BYO-HSM (customer KMS) and a signed BAA/SOC2 addendum. Can we get an indicative price + discount ask to put in the SOW?

prashant_solns: Quick clarifying q's: is the 3yr retention for full raw logs or summarized events? And do they want logs stored in our infra or shipped to their S3?

ben_sales: Full raw logs (required for forensics). Prefer us to retain; shipping is fallback. They're OK with egress charges but want us to guarantee immutability and access controls.

emily_secbiz: FYI for security — if logs are retained on our side for 3 years under HIPAA, we need: encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys, quarterly key rotation support (or documented rotation cadence), and audit of access (IAM logs). Also need to confirm our retention deletion workflow meets their legal hold requirements.

prashant_solns: Pricing sketch I can propose internally:
```
- Dedicated POC (6mo): base reserved capacity $X/month
- Audit-log retention add-on (3yr immutable): base fee + $0.12/GB/month tiered
- BYO-KMS integration: one-time integration & validation $Y (security review)
- HIPAA + SOC2 attestation add-on: $Z/mo (compliance package)
```
I recommend a 15% discount on the combined package for a 6mo paid commit to hit target ARR.

jessica_deal_desk: Heads-up — discounts > 20% need deal desk + revenue signoff. Anything at/under 15% is OK on standard approval path. If you want >15% you need to include: committed ARR, estimated MRR after discount, and any requested SLA/legal concessions.

ben_sales: Tentative numbers from customer: committed spend target $180k over 6mo if we include the 3yr logs + KMS support. They're pushing for a 25% off because they say this is a strategic POC.

marta_legal: If they're asking for 3yr immutable logs for HIPAA, we need to see a redline to the BAA and confirm data-subject/location constraints. Also: BYO-HSM/BYOK requires us to run key-exchange/attestation; vendor certs required. That increases integration cost and timeline (estimate 3-6 weeks).

prashant_solns: Given the timeline and integration risk, propose this package to customer: 15% discount + optional milestone credit at final acceptance (e.g., $10k credit) to bridge their ask for deeper discount. This keeps our margin and avoids a permanent price cut.

jessica_deal_desk: That milestone credit approach is approvable. Submit a short deal memo with: list price, discounted price, milestone credits, SOC2/HIPAA add-on SKU, and integration SOW. I'll flag for expedited review.

ben_sales: Copy — I'll draft the SOW today. Two quick asks before I submit: (1) confirm per-GB rate for long-term retention we should use in the memo, and (2) formal language for 'immutable retention' we should include so legal is happy.

prashant_solns: Use $0.12/GB/month for draft (we can adjust per volume). For immutable retention language, use: "Write-once, append-only storage with tamper-evident checksums and role-based access controls; retention enforcement via automated, auditable retention policies."

emily_secbiz: Also add: "Customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK) supported; Redwood will perform attestation and will not export keys from customer HSM. Access to logs by Redwood personnel requires documented justification and is logged."

marta_legal: Good. I'll prep the BAA/SOC2 addendum template and highlight BYOK attestation steps. Expect my redline within 48 hours.

ben_sales: Great — tagging @jessica_deal_desk for the memo path. Please escalate if you need >15% approval. I'll include the $10k milestone credit. Thanks :thumbsup: 

jessica_deal_desk: Roger. Once the memo is in, I'll route to revenue for the final sign-off. If customer insists on 25% we need exec approval and a clear washout clause if they terminate early.

prashant_solns: I'll also prep a short tech note for the customer outlining the 3-6 week integration tasks for BYO-HSM and the log immutability verification steps (attestation + checksum reports).

ben_sales: Perfect — will post the SOW & memo here when ready.

marta_legal: FYI — include retention disposition timelines and contact for legal hold requests in SOW.

ben_sales: Will do. Closing this thread for now, will reopen after memo upload.
